notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have cast at least three instants and/or sorceries this turn.
description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, creating a copy of Clockspinning targeting Crystalline Crawler for each other instant and sorcery you've cast each turn.
Resolve all copies of Clockspinning, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the original Clockspinning, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
